stories.title: Aave proposal could cut some lenders' interest share by 60%
stories.summary: A new Aave proposal could cut the interest share for some lenders by as much as 60%, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not specify which pools or lender groups the change would affect, or the stated reason for it.
stories.whyItMatters: Aave is one of the largest DeFi lending protocols. A change to its interest split could cut yields for a large group of on-chain lenders.
whatToWatch: Whether the proposal goes to a formal governance vote
The final terms if the vote passes
Community reaction from affected lenders
questions: Which pools or lender groups does the cut affect?
What is the stated reason for the change?

sources.title: Aave plan could cut some lenders’ share of interest by 60%

stories.title: Diesel prices drop 8% as Bitcoin traders face a squeeze
stories.summary: Diesel prices fell 8%, and separately, Bitcoin traders face a squeeze, according to CryptoSlate. The report links the two moves, but it does not explain the mechanism that connects them.
stories.whyItMatters: Readers should treat claimed links between energy prices and Bitcoin trader positioning with caution until a clear mechanism is shown.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin funding or liquidation data confirms a real squeeze
Any follow-up reporting that explains the diesel-Bitcoin link
questions: What specific data shows a trader squeeze?
Is the diesel price move actually connected to Bitcoin markets, or just coincidental timing?

sources.title: Diesel prices plunge 8%, yet Bitcoin traders face a squeeze

stories.title: Unocoin halts all services after hackers bypass a BitGo freeze
stories.summary: Indian crypto exchange Unocoin suspended all services after attackers reportedly bypassed a freeze that custodian BitGo had put in place, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not give a confirmed loss amount.
stories.whyItMatters: The incident raises doubts about how reliable custodian-level freezes are for stopping theft after a breach.
whatToWatch: A Unocoin statement on the scale of losses
Whether or when services resume
Any response or explanation from BitGo
questions: How much in user funds was taken?
How did attackers bypass the freeze?
Are all user funds safe?

sources.title: Unocoin halts all services after hackers bypass BitGo freeze

stories.title: Cost of hedging Bitcoin near $70,000 more than doubles in a day
stories.summary: The cost of hedging against Bitcoin price swings near $70,000 more than doubled in a single day, CryptoSlate reported. This points to a sharp jump in options market demand or implied volatility around that price level.
stories.whyItMatters: A fast rise in hedging costs often signals trader anxiety about near-term price swings, which matters to anyone sizing crypto risk.
whatToWatch: Whether hedging costs stay elevated or fall back
Price action around the $70,000 level
questions: What specific event drove the spike?
Which options or strikes does the data cover?

sources.title: The cost of a $70,000 Bitcoin hedge more than doubled in a day

stories.title: US courts pursue $1.2B in stolen Binance funds as victims hit a new hurdle
stories.summary: US courts are pursuing about $1.2 billion in funds stolen from Binance, but victims reportedly face a new obstacle in recovering their losses, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not detail the nature of that hurdle.
stories.whyItMatters: The outcome will set a precedent for how stolen exchange funds get returned to victims through US courts.
whatToWatch: Upcoming court rulings or forfeiture proceedings
Any claims process opened for victims
questions: What exactly is the new hurdle victims face?
What is the expected timeline for any fund distribution?

sources.title: US courts target $1.2B in stolen Binance funds, yet victims face a new hurdle

stories.title: Amazon says AI wrote its new cloud testing tool with no human code review
stories.summary: Amazon said no human wrote or reviewed the code behind its newly launched cloud testing tool, with the code produced entirely by AI, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not detail what testing or validation the tool received before release.
stories.whyItMatters: The move tests how far AI-written code can go without human review, a question that also applies to smart contract and crypto infrastructure code.
whatToWatch: How Amazon addresses security or audit concerns for the tool
Whether other cloud or crypto software providers adopt a similar approach
questions: What validation, if any, replaced human code review?
Could this approach extend to smart contract development?

sources.title: Amazon says no human wrote or reviewed the code for its new cloud testing tool

stories.title: Lido Earn's new safety net still leaves depositors exposed to losses
stories.summary: Liquid staking protocol Lido added a new safety-net feature to its Earn product, but depositors still bear ultimate responsibility for losses, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not detail the exact limits of the new safeguard.
stories.whyItMatters: Anyone using Lido's Earn product should know the backstop reduces, but does not remove, their downside risk.
whatToWatch: Full published terms and limits of the safety net
Any incident that tests the new safeguard in practice
questions: What specific losses remain the depositor's responsibility?
How does this differ from Lido Earn's prior loss arrangement?

sources.title: Lido Earn’s new safety net still leaves depositors on the hook for losses

stories.title: Report says yen intervention used euros, not dollars, reviving Bitcoin debate
stories.summary: A new US report found that an earlier intervention to support the Japanese yen was carried out using euros rather than dollars, CryptoSlate reported. Some commentators tie this detail to the broader debate over Bitcoin's role as an alternative to dollar-based reserves, though the link is not established by the report itself.
stories.whyItMatters: Currency choices in FX interventions feed debates about dollar dominance, a storyline Bitcoin bulls often cite, but the Bitcoin connection here is speculative and should be treated with caution.
whatToWatch: Further detail from the underlying report
Market commentary that tests or challenges the Bitcoin link
questions: Which agency or body issued the report?
What is the actual causal link, if any, to Bitcoin markets?

sources.title: New US report reveals yen rescue used euros, not dollars. That matters for Bitcoin

stories.title: XRP-backed loans trigger 883 liquidations, with $53M still at risk
stories.summary: Loans backed by XRP as collateral triggered 883 liquidations, and roughly $53 million in positions remain at risk, CryptoSlate reported. The report did not name the specific platform or platforms involved.
stories.whyItMatters: The scale of liquidations signals stress in XRP-collateralized lending and offers a gauge of leverage risk in that market.
whatToWatch: Further liquidations if XRP's price falls more
Which platforms carry the remaining at-risk positions
questions: Which platform or platforms saw these liquidations?
What triggered the underlying price move?

sources.title: XRP loans trigger 883 liquidations, and $53M remains at risk

stories.title: FBI warns of active $400M deepfake crypto scam that impersonates friends
stories.summary: The FBI warned of an active scam, tied to about $400 million in losses, that uses deepfake video to replace a trusted contact's face and impersonate friends of the victim, CryptoSlate reported. The warning targets crypto holders as a key group at risk.
stories.whyItMatters: Deepfake-enabled social engineering is a growing threat to crypto holders, since it exploits trust in familiar faces to drive transfers.
whatToWatch: Further FBI guidance or advisories on the scam
Any platform response to block or flag related transfers
questions: How are the stolen funds moved or laundered?
Which messaging or video platforms do scammers exploit most?

sources.title: FBI warns active $400M crypto scam targets your friends by replacing your face in videos
